title: Serializable transfers + internal service auth
summary: Fixes concurrent transfer race condition (negative balances) by wrapping transfer() in SERIALIZABLE transaction with retry and SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on both accounts ordered by id.
Adds `X-Internal-Service` header authentication path for internal services (payouts worker) to bypass user token requirement.
Changes affect core transfer logic, auth middleware, and introduce new internal routing endpoint.

issues.summary: Webhook notification (notifyTransfer) called inside SERIALIZABLE transaction; unclear if idempotent under retries
issues.evidence: Spot check src/ledger/transfer.ts shows notifyTransfer() called inside withSerializableRetry transaction. If transaction retries, webhook may be called multiple times. No idempotency key visible in function signature.
issues.scenario: Serialization failure triggers retry; notifyTransfer() fires again → partner webhook receives duplicate event → partner's retry-logic must be idempotent or deduplication fails.
issues.fix: Move notifyTransfer() outside transaction, or add deduplication key and document partner contract.
issues.confirm_or_refute: Full code review of src/db/txn.ts and internal.ts; verify webhook error handling and partner idempotency expectations.
issues.next_action: Reviewer: read full retry logic and confirm notification semantics in full-mode review.

issues.summary: X-Internal-Service auth path added without documented secret validation or header spoofing mitigations
issues.evidence: Spot check authMiddleware.ts shows header check: `if (svc && INTERNAL_SERVICES.includes(svc))` but INTERNAL_SERVICES list origin unknown; no mention of secret validation, TLS pinning, or header spoofing prevention.
issues.scenario: If INTERNAL_SERVICES is an environment list or hardcoded array, and X-Internal-Service is not validated against a shared secret or client certificate, an attacker with network access could impersonate payouts worker.
issues.fix: Document INTERNAL_SERVICES source and secret validation. Use HMAC or mTLS, not header-based auth alone.
issues.confirm_or_refute: Full review of auth logic and src/http/routes/internal.ts endpoint; verify INTERNAL_SERVICES list construction and secret/cert validation.
issues.next_action: Reviewer: audit auth path in full-mode deep-reader role; confirm secret validation is present.
